docs.purpose: Powers the search box on the tradesperson's tracked-jobs screen, letting them find any building permit in the city by typing part of an address or permit number, even outside the area they normally work in.
docs.data_story: It reads 3 tables — `permits`, `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `mobile/src/hooks/useSearchPermits.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: No geo-filtering by design (the header states search is app-wide). The response is the raw SQL rows passed straight through with no JS-level field-picking step, so it is not counted as a measured whitelist even though the SQL itself selects only five named columns. user_profiles/entitlements come from the shared getCurrentUserContext auth helper. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: CENSUS AGREEMENT on reads (permits, user_profiles, entitlements). CENSUS DISAGREEMENT on writes: census_writes is [], but the dev-mode profile seed at src/lib/auth/get-user-context.ts:84-88 is an INSERT into user_profiles on this route's path (gated isDevMode() && uid === 'dev-user', get-user-context.ts:83 — production-unreachable). Projection classed row_spread because the handler returns `result.rows` verbatim (route.ts:58) with no field pick; the surface is nonetheless bounded by the explicit 5-column SELECT at route.ts:22-27, so no `SELECT *` leak. Finding: unbounded-prefix ILIKE '%q%' over `permits` (route.ts:29-30) with no rate limit and no trailing-wildcard-only form — a two-character `q` is enough (schema min(2), route.ts:18). | Idempotency: N/A — GET, no writes other than the dev-only user_profiles seed at src/lib/auth/get-user-context.ts:84 which is `ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING` (get-user-context.ts:87) and therefore replay-safe. | Caching: none observed — no revalidate/dynamic/Cache-Control/unstable_cache in src/app/api/leads/search/route.ts:1-62 | Pagination: No client-controlled pagination. Hard `LIMIT 20` literal at src/app/api/leads/search/route.ts:32; no OFFSET, no cursor. `ORDER BY p.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST` (route.ts:31) is not a unique key, so row 20's identity is non-deterministic among ties. | No test file under src/tests/** imports this route.
